impact_map.area: Scope Unit instance container versus declaration Atom container

current_sources.finding: Scope Unit instances currently use a direct IS_CONTAINED_BY edge; generic cardinality is 0..1, plus a condition requires one for non-Project Units.
Project instance explicitly has zero IS_CONTAINED_BY edges and is the root Scope Unit.
External Scope Unit Declaration is the sole structural authority; it carries direct containment, and each non-root Scope Unit has one Parent while Project has none.
A Scope Unit Declaration Atom is external to the specific Scope Unit named by its active Subject; it does not create another Scope Unit.
Scope Unit Declaration's carrier is a Markdown Atom and its Claim is the governing source; this requires keeping the Atom's Header.Container distinct from the Scope Unit instance parent in the Claim.

Concrete example: this Atom's active Subject is Scope Unit//CORE_META_MODEL; its Claim declares the Scope Unit instance CORE_META_MODEL IS_CONTAINED_BY Scope Unit//METHODOLOGY_SOURCES; its own frontmatter has relations: {}. The future Header.Container on this Atom concerns the declaration Atom itself, not the CORE_META_MODEL instance's parent, even if the resulting target happens to be the same Scope Unit.

impact_map.replacement_map: Keep the two object-level facts separate. Atom.Header.Container belongs to each declaration Atom. The declared Scope Unit instance parent remains IS_CONTAINED_BY in that external Scope Unit Declaration Claim. No Scope Unit.Container/Parent property is introduced.

critical_distinction_example.atom_fact: The CA-R-2650 Declaration Atom has active Subject Scope Unit//CORE_META_MODEL; its own header is the Atom carrier metadata (currently relations: {}).
critical_distinction_example.scope_unit_instance_fact: Its Claim says the Scope Unit instance CORE_META_MODEL is IS_CONTAINED_BY Scope Unit//METHODOLOGY_SOURCES.
critical_distinction_example.interpretation: After migration, Header.Container on CA-R-2650 identifies the container of the declaration Atom. Its Claim-level IS_CONTAINED_BY identifies the parent of the Scope Unit instance named by subjects.active. These may resolve to the same Scope Unit, but have different hosts and must not be substituted for one another.
